content:
katie: quick check — aligning token-proofing contract for the sidecar -> compact ledger migration. RFC link: https://rfc.internal/compact-ledger-sidecar  any obvious blockers before we lock the contract?

ashish: overall looks fine. main risk is idempotency on replays/backfill. we need a stable claim identifier (not just timestamp) so reconciler can dedupe.

liam: to add: what if the sidecar emits a short lease token pre-claim to avoid double-claims in-flight? e.g. lease_id + expiry. cheaper than full canonicalization for hot paths.

maya: audit requirement: every claim event must include a provenance_ref that points back to the original request/event (guid). otherwise backfills become impossible to tie. audit team will need that for investigations.

charlie: cross-region failover scenario—if we rely on leases only, we can end up double-crediting during failover. prefer append-only storage on the ledger and dedupe at reconciliation as source-of-truth. sidecar can provide fast-path dedupe but must accept eventual reconciliation overwrites.

ashish: +1. compromise: append-only ingest, but sidecar populates a short_fingerprint and claim_hint to short-circuit obvious dups. reconciler uses full fingerprint and provenance_ref for final decision.

katie: can we sketch a minimal contract fields now? something like:  (example below)

```json
{
  "event_id": "string",            // unique id for this claim event (uuid)
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "source": "string",            // e.g. api, grpc, batch-backfill
  "tokens": 123,
  "fingerprint": "hex",          // canonicalized <model, prompt-hash, user-hash>
  "short_fingerprint": "hex8",   // cheap dedupe hint
  "provenance_ref": "string",    // pointer to original event in producer system
  "lease_id": "string|null",     // optional pre-claim lease id
  "claimed_at": "iso-ts",
  "handshake_version": "v2"
}
```

ingest-bot: ingest-bot ran quick contract validator against test corpus: compact-handshake v2 -> 82% pass, failing mainly on missing provenance_ref in backfills.

liam: rollout idea: canary tenants for 48h with parallel ingest (sidecar emits both old and new contract). run credits_reconcile_rate and duplicate_claim_rate dashboards. if deltas under threshold, flip. also keep backfill pipeline in verify-only mode for 7 days.

maya: surface two new error codes in responses: `duplicate_claim` and `stale_provenance`. will add to schema registry and docs.

ashish: implementation note: reconciler should accept event_id + fingerprint + provenance_ref. if event_id matches existing -> idempotent ACK. if different but fingerprint+provenance match -> mark as potential backfill duplicate and route to audit queue.

charlie: one more: include a small `origin_region` field so the reconciler can apply region-precedence rules during cross-region lag.

katie: excellent. action items: ashish -> quick dedupe prototype & unit tests, liam -> canary plan + dashboards, maya -> schema registry updates + audit codes, charlie -> reconcile region precedence doc stub. i'll schedule a 30m follow-up thursday to review canary thresholds. :thumbsup:

liam: noted. will post canary checklist by EOD tomorrow.

katie: thanks all.
